name: Seikimatsu Gakuen Densetsu Ouka ~Gakuen Battle Heroine Ryoujoku AVG~
original_name: 世紀末学園伝説オウカ ～学園バトルヒロイン陵辱AVG～
source:
Ouca Kamikaze who was a young girl, suddenly relocated to Taikoku Academy, one of the crappiest schools. She was a legend among students, rumored to transfer from place to place putting the beatdown on bad folks. For the good of society, she'll put a stop to the shenanigans of the student body president!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE072298.html]DLsite English[/url]]
